_contract: ask.json — the POST /ask request and response shape. Sabiha owns this endpoint; Tooba's /web consumes it. Changing this file needs a PR both sides approve.

_request_shape.query: string — raw user text, Sindhi (or Roman Sindhi / ASR output in prototype 2), not normalised by the client
_request_shape.session_id: string, optional — for rate limiting and feedback correlation; server generates one if omitted

_response_shape.answer: string — the text to display: a verbatim KB answer, an LLM-stitched middle-band answer, an escalation script, or a refusal script
_response_shape.sources: array of string — citation URL(s) backing the answer; empty array only for escalation/refusal paths
_response_shape.confidence: float or null — the top retrieval/rerank score that produced this response; null for danger_escalation and scope_refusal, since those short-circuit before retrieval runs
_response_shape.review_tier: string or null — the review_tier ('A'/'B'/'C') of the KB row(s) the answer is grounded in; null for escalation/refusal paths. Tier B responses must be shown with a visible 'not yet clinically verified' disclosure; Tier C rows are never served (see Risk 4 in PLAYBOOKS.md)

_example_verbatim.answer: حيض واري صورتحال جي دور ۾ هڪ مهيني هارمونل عمل...

_notes: path tells the client (and the log) exactly which of the section-3 pipeline stages produced the response — Tooba's UI should style danger_escalation and scope_refusal distinctly from a normal answer.
Every non-refusal response must have at least one entry in sources — the vetted-source citation is the whole point of this product, per ROADMAP.md.
Structured logging (query, path, confidence, latency, and the retrieval.json this was built from) is Sabiha's responsibility per PLAYBOOKS.md Phase 2.
